senses.zh_definition: 古德斯皮德：英语姓氏，也可构成机构等专名的一部分；确切指称依上下文确定。
senses.en_definition: Goodspeed, an English surname also occurring in institutional and other proper names.
senses.ms_definition: Nama keluarga Inggeris yang juga boleh menjadi sebahagian nama khas organisasi atau entiti lain; takrif penerangan, bukan definisi rasmi DBP.
senses.nuances: 未核实为 DBP 马来语正式词条。不能自动把它解释为“速度快”，也不能不经语境判断就改为祝福语 Godspeed。姓氏来源见 [Dictionary of American Family Names，经 Ancestry 展示](https://www.ancestry.com/last-name-meaning/goodspeed?geo-lang=en)；机构名称实例见 [Goodspeed Musicals](https://www.goodspeed.org/about/about-goodspeed)。下列短语用于说明名称在马来语句法中的位置，不代表高频搭配统计。

etymology.historical_story: The surname Goodspeed is traced to a Middle English expression wishing success to someone beginning an undertaking. The family-name dictionary suggests that it became a nickname for someone who regularly used that expression. This historical connection explains its relationship with Godspeed, but does not make the two spellings interchangeable in a person’s name. See [Dictionary of American Family Names](https://www.ancestry.com/last-name-meaning/goodspeed?geo-lang=en).
etymology.cognitive_memory_aid: 用 good 与 speed 的熟悉字形记住姓氏拼写；这种拆字只是记忆提示，不是马来语构词分析。

cultural_pragmatics.politeness_note: 称呼姓名持有者时保留其本人使用的拼写和称谓，不把姓氏直译为“好速度”。
cultural_pragmatics.usage_etiquette: 用于姓名、机构名称及相关介绍。若本意是祝旅途或事业顺利，应另查 Godspeed；日常马来语可按情境使用 semoga berjaya 或 selamat jalan。
